{{Quote|I don't think it was a rat. Call secur…|The EV-series droid|<ref name="The Gathering Storm" />}}
An [[EV-series supervisor droid]] served as a '''sous-chef droid''' in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Bib Fortuna]], who had taken it over from its previous owner, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]], following the [[crime lord]]'s [[death]]. While the [[sous-chef]] [[droid]] worked in the palace kitchen alongside a [[Unidentified COO-series cook droid|COO-series cook droid]], the two heard a noise from nearby. Though the [[EV-series]] assumed the disturbance was a [[rat]], the source of the sound had been the former [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] and [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], who had infiltrated the palace to retrieve Fett's [[Slave I|starship]]. The cook droid sent the EV-series to investigate, and the sous-chef droid came across an open grate that Fett and Shand had exited through. Realizing the noise had not been a rat, the sous-chef ordered its companion to call for security, but Fett knocked the EV-series droid down with his [[Gaderffii stick|gaffi stick]].<ref name="The Gathering Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sous-chef droid appeared in flashbacks during the [[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm|fourth episode]] of the [[Disney+]] streaming series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''.<ref name="The Gathering Storm" /> Although uncredited in the show itself, [[Sam Witwer]] provided the voice for the droid. During [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration 2022]], Witwer referred to the character as [[EV-9D9]], stating that he modeled his performance after [[Richard Marquand]]'s portrayal of that character in [[1983]]'s {{Film|VI}}.<ref name="Sam Witwer Credit">{{YouTube|video=Z8UdXvynS50|text=Sam Witwer - Matt Lanter - Star Wars Celebration 2022 - DAY 4 Panel|channel=UCX2BSSVDZbk5PrppNQREfTA|name=Super Steve|date=29-05-2022|quote=I don't know if you guys know that I did EV-9D9. […] I'm like, 'Now wait a second. What I'll do is I'll say the lines from ''Jedi'' and then say the lines from ''Book of Boba'' to make sure that it's the right cadence.'|archivedate=20220821052801}}</ref> However, Witwer's sous-chef is unlikely to be the same droid, as EV-9D9 was previously established to have become a [[bartender]] at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Chapter 5: The Gunslinger|fifth episode]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Connections">{{DisneyGallery|Connections}}</ref> which takes place concurrently to ''Boba Fett''{{'s}} flashbacks.<ref name="The Gathering Storm" />
